_comment: Spec-driven-kit hooks (kit templates/claude-hooks-settings.json, adapted). Stop hook deliberately omits trace-audit: this is a Mode B project (.feature files ARE the spec, no REQ IDs), so trace-audit would report findings on every turn end and block forever. check-guard blocks only on exit 1 (weakening found); exit >= 2 is environment/not-applicable and never blocks.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && ./scripts/check-guard.bb; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 1 ]; then echo 'check-guard found check-weakening - resolve per CLAUDE.md (do not weaken checks) or report to the human.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
